summary: dsh-launch is a DSH plugin for running and managing long-lived services in a detached broker process, with a sidebar and model tools for starting, stopping, restarting, listing, and viewing service logs.

classificationSuggestion.reason: This plugin is primarily a service orchestration and management tool for DSH web sessions: it adds a Service tab and model tools to start/stop/restart/list/log long-running processes, while a detached broker supervises those processes across conversation/session boundaries with restart and readiness logic. The main risk is local process lifecycle control (arbitrary command execution and log/state file handling), which matches an automation/orchestration utility class.
